comments.author: @balanpalaniappan6015
comments.text: I am from Tamil Nadu. The fish curry and chicken curry we make at home (by village folks) has been the best when it comes to taste. I have eaten in all types of restaurants but no match to what we make at home. We don't use too many masala and yet it tastes so good. Youshould try the home made stuff. A word of caution, they will be chilli hot and yet yummy
